text_block_list.text: During training, Air Groove swayed on her feet, so...
choice_data_list: Are you short on sleep, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, I'm a bit short on sleep.
The moon was so beautiful last night, so—"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
choice_data_list: Saying that only makes me more curious.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Well... it's just that I felt like indulging in some reading under the moonlight...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Aargh, you brought this on yourself.
Time for training!
Afterward, she returned to training, but she still seemed out of sorts...
